streak_assessment: Recomputed from the retained records and .autoloop/state.json (last_completed_experiment exp-0093, champion still exp-0089 / commit 4a0c988): four consecutive scientifically completed non-improvements since the exp-0089 promotion — exp-0090 quadratic king-danger (18-29-17, 0.508), exp-0091 rank-scaled passed pawns (21-26-17, 0.531), exp-0092 open/half-open rook files (17-29-18, 0.492), exp-0093 doubled/isolated pawns (14-34-16, 0.484). exp-0093's own record carries consecutive_non_improvements:3 (pre-increment); the true post-batch streak is 4, against the stop threshold of 5, so the numeric condition is not met. The qualitative condition also is not met, but the picture has narrowed. The search / move-ordering / quiescence / time-management family remains exhausted in its tested form (verified against the handoff list: history/killer/TT-best-move, aspiration, guarded null-move, bounded check extensions/evasions, forcing-check priority, mate-distance, quiet promotions, delta pruning, contempt, halfmove-clock TT bucketing / early repetition-probe guarding, timeout unwinding, quiescence stalemate repair, ordering-key micro-opt, clock reallocation). Within leaf evaluation, the specific sub-mechanism "one cheap hand-weighted flat additive positional scalar folded into _model_evaluate" is now itself effectively saturated: four orthogonal features (king danger, passed pawns, rook files, pawn structure) all landed inside arena noise 0.48–0.53, and the only remaining pre-authorised term of that kind (bishop pair) is a near-constant material scalar with the weakest progress-gradient motivation of the set — spending the 5th slot on it is not well-motivated. However, one materially different, well-motivated, self-contained experiment that has never been tried and is absent from the registry and both exhausted lists remains: changing how the search itself recognises a draw by repetition (first in-tree recurrence scored as a draw, instead of waiting for the on-board threefold claim). That is a search-semantics change, not another leaf scalar and not draw contempt (exp-0063 changed the draw value; exp-0068/exp-0082 changed repetition-probe performance; neither changed detection timing). It targets the single largest score reservoir in the evidence. Decision is CONTINUE.
recurring_failure_modes: Non-forced repetition draws from equal-or-better positions are the dominant failure mode and unchanged across exp-0090..exp-0093: exp-0093 had 34/64 draws, ~28 by non-forced threefold repetition, with PGNs showing the candidate reaching an equal or materially better middlegame/endgame and then oscillating pieces with no progress plan (game 1: Rg6/Rh6 and Rg3 rook shuffle in a balanced position; game 11: Nf4/Nd3 knight oscillation; game 3: candidate a clean piece up in an R+minor ending and still drawn by repetition). The accepted mobility term (exp-0089) and the four subsequent positional terms did not remove this because in locked/simplified positions every candidate move evaluates near-equally, so alpha-beta has no reason to prefer a non-repeating move, and the engine only recognises the draw at the on-board third occurrence (via _forced_draw's is_repetition(3)) when it is already too late to steer away.

All 16 losses in exp-0093 are checkmates, skewed toward the candidate playing White, via long (30-70 move) king hunts after passive simplification or against an uncastled king (e.g. the Dutch and one Nimzo line). exp-0090 attacked this column directly with a static king-danger term and did not move the score, indicating the mates are downstream of weak endgame/defensive technique and drift into passive positions rather than a missing static king-attack scalar.

Endgame conversion is weak: the engine repeatedly fails to convert extra material or an extra passed pawn and fails to make progress in better rook endings, which feeds both the repetition draws and, on further drift, the king-hunt losses. A rank-scaled passed-pawn term (exp-0091) was the most on-target leaf fix and still only reached 0.531.

Four consecutive cheap flat hand-weighted additive positional leaf terms (king danger 0.508, passed pawns 0.531, rook files 0.492, doubled/isolated pawns 0.484) have all failed to clear promotion against this baseline, all with clean CI/reliability/ablation/resource gates and zero agent failures. This sub-mechanism (single flat scalar in _model_evaluate) is now saturated; the remaining pre-authorised member (bishop pair) shares the weakest motivation and should not consume the last streak slot. Genuinely new directions are now required, and if the next experiment also fails the correct follow-up is to flag an offline positional-feature retrain of weights/model.json for the human rather than iterate more scalars.

next_direction.title: Single-repetition draw detection inside the search tree
next_direction.hypothesis: The champion's _forced_draw scores a repetition as a draw only at the on-board third occurrence (board.is_repetition(3)); inside the search tree the engine therefore walks into repetition lines and only recognises them one full cycle too late to steer away, which is the direct cause of the ~28/64 non-forced repetition draws from equal-or-better positions. Recognising the FIRST in-tree recurrence of a position as a draw (score 0.0) will give alpha-beta a correctly-timed reason to reject a repeating move whenever any non-repeating alternative evaluates even marginally higher (which, combined with the already-accepted 3 cp/square mobility gradient, it usually does when the engine stands better), converting a meaningful share of those draws to wins, while still allowing the engine to head into a repetition when it is worse (0.0 beats a negative eval). Concretely: in get_move, before the iterative-deepening loop, capture a module global _root_ply = len(board.move_stack). In _forced_draw(board), when len(board.move_stack) > _root_ply return True if board.is_repetition(2) (current position has occurred at least once earlier in the combined game+search move stack); when len(board.move_stack) <= _root_ply keep the existing board.is_repetition(3) check so the actual root is never instantly declared drawn and iterative deepening always yields a move even if the root already repeats earlier game history. Keep the halfmove_clock >= 100 and is_insufficient_material checks unchanged, and keep exactly one is_repetition call per node (is_repetition(2) subsumes the threefold case past the root), so node cost is unchanged. No new leaf term, no change to _model_evaluate, move ordering, quiescence capture logic, the transposition table, _budget_seconds or the deepening loop.
next_direction.rationale: The dominant retained failure mode across four straight experiments is non-forced repetition draws from equal-or-better positions, and it is the largest single reservoir of recoverable points (34 draws in exp-0093, most non-forced). Four cheap flat positional leaf scalars have all failed to move it because they do not change the fact that the search cannot see the draw coming until the third occurrence. This mechanism attacks the failure at its actual cause — draw-detection timing in the search — and is standard engine practice (treat the first repetition in the tree as a draw). It is materially different from every exhausted mechanism: exp-0063 draw contempt changed the VALUE assigned to a known draw; exp-0068/exp-0082 changed the PERFORMANCE of the repetition probe (halfmove-clock TT bucketing, skipping impossible probes); neither changed WHEN a repetition is recognised as a draw, and no experiment in the 48-record window has. It is fully self-contained: about six lines in agent.py, one module global, no new coefficients, no weights change, no training pipeline, and it keeps the trained model entirely determinative of every non-drawn leaf.
next_direction.guardrails: Scope: edit only agent.py; weights/ unchanged; no change to _model_evaluate, _ordered_moves, _quiescence capture/pruning, the TT key or size, _budget_seconds, or the iterative-deepening loop. NPS/leaf cost: the change replaces one board.is_repetition(3) call with one board.is_repetition(2) call (identical complexity) plus an O(1) len(move_stack) compare and a global read, so target node cost within ~1.03x; confirm search still reaches comparable depth in the arena. Reliability/flag risk: the len(board.move_stack) > _root_ply guard guarantees the root is never scored as an immediate draw, so get_move always returns a legal UCI move even when the root repeats prior history; the early return in _forced_draw occurs before any TT store in _negamax, so a twofold-draw score is never written to or reused from the transposition table in a non-repeating context (do not add a TT store on that path). Re-verify the full stress_time_left_ms grid (1 / 25 / 100 / 1000 / 120000) with required_failures 0 and init under 50 s — exp-0093's worst single move was 0.84 s against the 2.25 s ceiling and 0.041 s against 0.75 s at the 1 s clock, and this change adds no work, so the margin must be preserved. Must hold model-move-ablation with minimum_move_differences >= 8 and the strength gate (>= 0.625) at the 3 s ablation clock; repetition lines are rare in the ablation openings so ablation drift risk is low, but confirm. Use only documented python-chess API (board.move_stack, board.is_repetition); never read library internals. If the paired arena is inconclusive, do NOT re-tune this by changing the fold count, adding a material-scaled or side-relative draw score (that is exp-0063's exhausted contempt mechanism), or adding a repetition-aware TT flag and calling it a new experiment — that outcome is the 5th consecutive non-improvement, and the next audit should weigh stop_condition scientific_saturation and flag an offline positional-feature retrain of weights/model.json (pawn structure, king shelter, passed pawns as trained features) for the human, since the self-contained hand-weighted options will then be exhausted.

audit_summary: Champion is agent.py at commit 4a0c988 (recorded as exp-0089): PVS/LMR negamax with exchange-aware capture ordering and losing-capture pruning in quiescence, a depth-keyed transposition table keyed on (transposition_key, halfmove_clock, depth), partial root-iteration salvage, and a fast draw/terminal path (_forced_draw = halfmove_clock>=100 OR is_repetition(3) OR insufficient material), over a tapered learned piece-square model, plus the accepted fixed 3 cp/square net-mobility leaf term and a flat castling-rights scalar. The batch just completed produced exp-0093: a flat 12 cp doubled-pawn / 14 cp isolated-pawn penalty folded into _model_evaluate via an 8-int per-file tally (the previous audit's chosen direction). It returned an inconclusive paired arena (14-34-16, score 0.484, CI [0.413, 0.557]) with CI, reliability stress (worst move 0.84 s vs 2.25 s ceiling), model-move-ablation (27 divergent moves vs minimum 8), resource and policy gates all clean and zero agent failures; not promoted, so pawn-structure penalties are not in the champion. This is the fourth consecutive scientific non-improvement since exp-0089 (exp-0090 king-danger 0.508, exp-0091 passed pawns 0.531, exp-0092 rook files 0.492, exp-0093 pawn structure 0.484), against a stop threshold of five. exp-0093's retained games show the failure modes unchanged: 34/64 draws, roughly 28 by non-forced threefold repetition from equal-or-better positions with aimless piece shuffling (including one game a clean piece up), and all 16 losses are checkmates skewed toward the candidate as White via long king hunts after passive simplification. The search/ordering/quiescence/time family is exhausted in its tested form, and within leaf evaluation the specific sub-mechanism of a single cheap flat hand-weighted positional scalar is now also effectively saturated (four orthogonal features all in arena noise 0.48–0.53); the one remaining pre-authorised such term, bishop pair, has the weakest motivation of the set. Decision: CONTINUE, stop_condition null, because one materially different, well-motivated, self-contained experiment remains that no record in the 48-experiment window has tried and that attacks the dominant failure mode at its cause: changing the search's draw-by-repetition detection so the first in-tree recurrence of a position is scored as a draw (via a _root_ply guard plus board.is_repetition(2) past the root in _forced_draw), instead of waiting for the on-board threefold claim. This is distinct from draw contempt (exp-0063, which changed the draw value) and from repetition-probe performance work (exp-0068/exp-0082), adds no node cost (one is_repetition call per node, unchanged), touches no protected surface, no weights, no time management and no TT structure, and keeps the trained model determinative of every non-drawn leaf. If it is inconclusive it is the fifth consecutive non-improvement and the next audit should weigh scientific_saturation and flag an offline positional-feature retrain of weights/model.json for the human rather than iterate further scalars. Uploading remains out of scope; the live competition upload is a separate older exp-0052-era artifact (state.json shows v3 / checksum 55fec84c6dab tied to the exp-0089 champion is active) and this audit does not touch it.
